creditKey.description: Send as Authorization: Bearer xs_... Prepaid credit API key (xs_...), bought at /pricing#credits. 1 credit = $0.001. Alternative to x402 payment.

info.title: x402serps
info.x-guidance: POST JSON to any /api/v1 endpoint. Unpaid calls return HTTP 402 with x402 v2 PAYMENT-REQUIRED (USDC on Base or Solana); retry with PAYMENT-SIGNATURE (v2) or X-PAYMENT (v1). Start with /api/v1/search {q}. Bundles: /api/v1/competitor-report {domain,keywords}, /api/v1/leads {q,location}, /api/v1/seo-audit {domain}, /api/v1/news-digest {topics}. Alternative auth: Authorization: Bearer xs_... prepaid credit key. Free tier: the MCP server at https://x402serps.com/api/mcp gives 20 free web_search/extract calls a day with no payment or key.
info.description: Pay-per-call web search, news, and extraction via x402 (HTTP 402, then retry with X-PAYMENT header). USDC on Base or Solana. Or prepaid card credits: Authorization: Bearer xs_... (see /pricing#credits).
